description: Source code for FreeType library's color filtering API, including FIR filter implementation for subpixel bitmap glyphs, with functions to set LCD filter weights and filter types.

methods.name: _ft_lcd_filter_fir
methods.description: Applies FIR filter to bitmap for LCD rendering modes, filtering horizontally or vertically based on mode.

methods.name: FT_Library_SetLcdFilterWeights
methods.description: Sets the weights used for LCD filtering in the FreeType library.

methods.name: FT_Library_SetLcdFilter
methods.description: Configures the LCD filter type used in FreeType rendering.
